notes.title: ASDAD Christmas Update is finally Here!
notes.notes:
We are pretty close to Christmas and I've got a little surprise for all of you guys! You should all be able to update to version 3.0 of the game now, which adds a New Guest Character and a number of improvements to the game! (It also has a small Christmas surprise!)

For instance now there's a Single Player (Practice!) Race for the Idol mode, color-coded hint ribbons in item boxes, slightly improved progress saving, reworked voice acting, etc.

You can read the full official announcement on our website.

Hope you all have a Merry Christmas and thanks again for your support!
